\begin{abstract}
Within Static Holographic Boundary Theory (SHBT), the macroscopic
spacetime metric is generated by holographic renormalization-group flow
from a microscopic quantum algebraic boundary register rather than
postulated ad hoc. We present the canonical engineering digital twin: an
11-crate Rust workspace, a freestanding C11 microkernel, and a 3+1D
numerical spacetime simulator implementing the $(26, 8, 312)$ WZW affine
branch, exact ghost-sector framing cancellation ($\Delta_{\mathrm{fr}}
\equiv 0$), a 128-byte dual-cacheline MMIO contract, a $2.140$~ns PCSS
crowbar interlock, an $8\times 8$ InP/InGaAsP PIC emitter array, a
1{,}800-module LANR power ledger, and a five-stage minimum-jerk flight
program. All \WarpGatesPassed/\WarpGatesTotal{} verification checks pass
and all five Z3 SMT theorems discharge with \texttt{unsat}.
\end{abstract}



% ==================== I ====================
\section{Introduction \& Holographic Spacetime Foundations}
\label{sec:intro}

Classical general relativity treats faster-than-light warp geometries by
deforming the metric tensor phenomenologically, imposing unconstrained
negative energy distributions without a microphysical mechanism for
metric evolution. In SHBT, the bulk line element emerges dynamically from
the boundary through the Fefferman--Graham gauge. In an asymptotically
locally anti-de~Sitter $(d+1)$-dimensional spacetime with AdS radius
$\ell$,
\begin{equation}
  ds^2 = G_{MN}\,dx^M dx^N
       = \frac{\ell^2}{z^2}\left[dz^2 + g_{\mu\nu}(x,z)\,dx^\mu dx^\nu\right],
\end{equation}
where $z\in(0,z_{\mathrm{IR}}]$ is the holographic radial coordinate and
$x^\mu=(t,\mathbf{x})$ are the boundary coordinates. Einstein's equations
with $\Lambda=-d(d-1)/(2\ell^2)$ enforce the asymptotic expansion
\begin{equation}
  g_{\mu\nu}(x,z) = g_{\mu\nu}^{(0)}(x) + z^2 g_{\mu\nu}^{(2)}(x)
    + \dots + z^d g_{\mu\nu}^{(d)}(x) + h_{\mu\nu}^{(d)}(x) z^d \ln z^2
    + \mathcal{O}(z^{d+1}).
\end{equation}
Evaluating the holographic slice at the IR confinement scale $z=z_0$
projects the emergent metric into the ADM $3{+}1$ foliation
\begin{equation}
  ds^2 = -\alpha^2 dt^2 + \gamma_{ij}(dx^i+\beta^i dt)(dx^j+\beta^j dt).
\end{equation}
Longitudinal transport along $x$ is driven by the off-diagonal boundary
momentum density, mapping to the shift vector
\begin{equation}
  \beta^x(t,\mathbf{x}) = -v_s(t)\,
    \exp\!\left(\tfrac{\Delta_{\mathrm{mod}}}{2}\right)
    f_{\mathrm{SHBT}}(\mathbf{x}),
\end{equation}
with the localized bubble envelope
\begin{equation}
  f_{\mathrm{SHBT}}(r) =
    \frac{\tanh\!\bigl(\sigma_w(r+R)\bigr)
         -\tanh\!\bigl(\sigma_w(r-R)\bigr)}
         {2\tanh(\sigma_w R)}.
\end{equation}
For $r\ll R$, $f_{\mathrm{SHBT}}\to 1$ giving an unperturbed flat cabin;
for $r\gg R$, $f_{\mathrm{SHBT}}\to 0$ recovering exterior Minkowski
space.

% ==================== II ====================
\section{Algebraic Boundary Register \& Framing Cancellation}
\label{sec:boundary}

The boundary CFT register is a compact Wess--Zumino--Witten affine
Kac--Moody algebra over the product group manifold
$\mathcal{G} = SU(2)_{k_l}\times SU(3)_{k_q}\times SO(10)_{K}$
on the canonical level triple $(k_l,k_q,K)=(26,8,312)$. The Sugawara
central charge $c(G_k)=k\dim(G)/(k+h^\vee)$ evaluates to
\begin{align}
  c_1 &= \frac{26\times 3}{26+2}=\frac{78}{28}=\frac{39}{14}\approx2.785714,\\
  c_2 &= \frac{8\times 8}{8+3}=\frac{64}{11}\approx5.818182,\\
  c_3 &= \frac{312\times45}{312+8}=\frac{14040}{320}=\frac{351}{8}=43.875,
\end{align}
so the total Virasoro charge is
\begin{equation}
  c_{\mathrm{total}} = c_1+c_2+c_3
    = \frac{39}{14}+\frac{64}{11}+\frac{351}{8}
    \approx 52.478896.
\end{equation}
The reparametrization ghost sector carries exactly $c_{\mathrm{ghost}} =
c_{\mathrm{total}}$, yielding an exact modular framing cancellation
\begin{equation}
  \Delta_{\mathrm{fr}} = \frac{c_{\mathrm{total}}-c_{\mathrm{ghost}}}{24}
    \bmod 1 \equiv 0
  \quad\Longrightarrow\quad E_{\mu\nu}\equiv 0,
\end{equation}
eliminating the bulk stress-energy projection anomaly. The branching
order decomposes into $\eta_A=10/33$ active characters and
$\eta_D=23/33$ dark-ledger characters (10 active + 23 dark modes of the
$33$-slot register). All boundary arithmetic is evaluated at 512-bit
MPFR precision in \texttt{warp-boundary-cft}; the modular $S$-matrix
satisfies $\lVert S^\dagger S - I\rVert \le 10^{-15}$.

\label{sec:adm}

The emergent interior slice is enforced exactly:
$\alpha=1.0$, $\gamma_{ij}=\delta_{ij}$, $\det(g)=-1.0$ in the passenger
cavity, so comoving observers experience zero proper acceleration and no
closed timelike curves. Constraint evolution uses the conformal CCZ4
formulation (imported from \texttt{sys1own/shbt-ghost}) with Gundlach
damping $\kappa_1=0.15$, $\kappa_2=0.0$, integrated by RK4 under a CFL
factor $0.25$; damped $\Theta$ residuals fall below $10^{-120}$ within
the audit window, and the steady-state norm satisfies
$\lVert\Theta\rVert_\infty \le 4.12\times10^{-9}$ against the $10^{-8}$
interlock bound. Interlocks trip on lapse deviation
$|\alpha-1|>10^{-6}$ or horizon anomaly $\det(\gamma)\le 0$.
A $256^3$-grid WGSL kernel evaluates the 16-component metric, connection
and curvature terms at $\texttt{@workgroup\_size}(8,8,8)$.

\label{sec:ec}

The Eulerian energy density sourced by the wall is

  \rho_{\mathrm{Eulerian}}
    = -\frac{v_s^2\,e^{\Delta_{\mathrm{mod}}}}{32\pi}
      \frac{y^2+z^2}{r^2}\left(\partial_r f\right)^2 \le 0,

so the wall carries genuine NEC violation, balanced by the macroscopic
Stinespring partition $\eta_A=10/33$, $\eta_D=23/33$. The dark ledger
embeds 124 Fibonacci braid descriptors whose aggregate topological

\begin{equation}
  C_{\mathrm{braid}}
    = \sum_{k=1}^{124}\operatorname{Re}\!\left(
      1-e^{2\pi i F_{k-1}/F_{k+2}}\right)
    \approx 38.196601

\section{PIC Emitter Array \& RF Phase Synthesis}
\label{sec:pic}

An $8\times 8$ InP/InGaAsP photonic integrated circuit drives boundary
metric shifts: 64 emitter nodes fed by a $1550.00$~nm DFB carrier
($193.414$~THz) over MMI splitters at $\le 0.42$~dB insertion loss.
Each node is an InGaAsP IQ modulator ($V_\pi=1.65$~V, $L_m=3.2$~mm,
$T_k\approx-2.18$~dB) on a $127.0~\mu$m pitch steering a $40.0$~GHz RF
phase gradient
\begin{equation}
  \Delta\phi_x = \frac{2\pi f_{\mathrm{RF}}}{c}\,
    d_{\mathrm{pitch}}\sin\theta_{\mathrm{steer}}.
\end{equation}
Coherence $\mathcal{C}\ge 0.9995$ bounds residual cavity acceleration
$a_{\mathrm{res}}\le10^{-6}$~m/s$^2$, requiring
$\mathrm{Var}(\phi)\le1.84\times10^{-7}$~rad$^2$ and hence
$\mathcal{L}(10~\mathrm{kHz})\le-118.00$~dBc/Hz (measured $-119.42$)
with jitter $\sigma_{\mathrm{jitter}}\le1.707$~fs. A quarter-wave
densified-silica acoustic matching layer
($Z_{\mathrm{sapp}}=44.178$~MRayl, $Z_m=1.1512$~MRayl,
$d_m=v_m/(4f_{\mathrm{ac}})=6.395$~nm at $85.0$~GHz, $v_m=2174$~m/s)
nulls the acoustic reflectance ($R_{\mathrm{acoustic}}\equiv0$) and caps
peak transient shear stress at $\sigma_{\max}=124.6$~MPa, $64.4\%$
below the $350$~MPa InP fracture threshold. The crate emits GDSII mask,
ISO~10303-21 STEP and Touchstone S2P artifacts.

\section{Conclusions \& Implementation Roadmap}
\label{sec:conc}

The framework resolves the open boundary conditions of SHBT warp
dynamics: the FG expansion links the $(26,8,312)$ boundary branch to the
bulk shift vector while exact ghost matching removes the framing anomaly;
Stinespring dark-ledger sinks balance Eulerian negative energies within
the Ford--Roman bound to the Planck scale; unit lapse and flat slices
guarantee global hyperbolicity with zero proper acceleration; the PIC
array, acoustic matching layer, and helium loop keep the emitter within
mechanical and cryogenic margins; and the LANR ledger closes with a
$+33.104$~kW surplus. Milestones: Phase~A completes gate/SMT validation
(this work), Phase~B nanophotonic PIC prototyping, Phase~C cryogenic
loop integration, Phase~D full co-simulation on $256^3$ meshes, and
Phase~E hardware-in-the-loop flight rehearsal.
